optimizedDescription.value: Defines capability-aware skill/agent template sources, metadata contracts, rendering, runtime frontmatter, and workflow command guidance.

optimizedContext.value:
# Skill templates source

## Rules
- Sources: `packages/skills/templates/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md.tpl`; agents: `templates/agents/<agent-name>/SPECD-AGENT.md.tpl`. Installed outputs remove `.tpl`.
- Every directory owns `skill.meta.json` or `specd-agent.meta.json`: kind, supported/required capabilities, shared templates.
- Deterministic single-pass Handlebars; capabilities choose MCP/agents/frontmatter behavior. Shared reference exactly `@{{sharedFolder}}/shared.md`.
- Graph guidance: `--direction dependents|dependencies`; `--file` for file impact; snippets only explicit preview; no `--changes`.
- Templates contain no static frontmatter. Plugins supply structured `variables.frontmatter`; skills inject target-supported runtime fields locally.
- Workflow templates use implementation tracking links, metadata self-healing only for repair, in-place approvals, reconciled invalidation, correct overlap distinction and archive hook behavior.
- Optimizers gate on top-level `llmOptimizedContext`; use persisted `specs optimizations set` direct fields, never metadata gate/input mixing/regeneration.
- Fast-track records decisions continuously, then summarizes; uses governing context, confirmation, and dependents terminology.

## Constraints
- No static YAML frontmatter or absolute installed paths.
- `.md.tpl` sources; every skill directory has metadata.
- Runtime fields limited to target support.
